description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git apply' commands, including error cases for unrecognized input, no-op patches, and invalid option combinations. It sets up test scenarios, runs 'git apply' commands with various flags and inputs, and verifies expected failures or successes.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Sets up an initial commit for testing.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command and expects it to fail, failing the test if it does not.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a series of commands and expects them to succeed.
